tables","articleBody":"Please can we have DNT and `doNotTrack` support added to caniuse.com\n\nThe 'Do Not Track' privacy initiative is implemented first at an HTTP Header level, e.g. `DNT:1` and then exposed on the `window` and `navigator` objects in the DOM as `doNotTrack` depending on the User Agent.\n\nCurrent implementations:\n- `navigator.doNotTrack`\n- `navigator.msDoNotTrack` (IE 9-10)\n- `window.doNotTrack` (IE 11+, Safari 7+)\n\nSee:\n- W3.org spec (Working Draft): https://www.w3.org/TR/tracking-dnt/\n- MDN Guide on the Do Not Track initiative: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Security/Do_not_track_field_guide\n- MDN Article on `navigator.doNotTrack`: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Navigator/doNotTrack\n\nAs a web developer, I'm interested in a JS polyfill that would check the User Agent for the user's Do Not Track setting. class="markdown-body" data-turbolinks="false"><div class="markdown-body safe-html-box__Uwc6Al"><p dir="auto">Please can we have DNT and <code class="notranslate">doNotTrack</code> support added to caniuse.com</p>
<p dir="auto">The 'Do Not Track' privacy initiative is implemented first at an HTTP Header level, e.g. <code class="notranslate">DNT:1</code> and then exposed on the <code class="notranslate">window</code> and <code class="notranslate">navigator</code> objects in the DOM as <code class="notranslate">doNotTrack</code> depending on the User Agent.</p>
<p dir="auto">Current implementations:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code class="notranslate">navigator.doNotTrack</code></li>
<li><code class="notranslate">navigator.msDoNotTrack</code> (IE 9-10)</li>
<li><code class="notranslate">window.doNotTrack</code> (IE 11+, Safari 7+)</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">See:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>W3.org spec (Working Draft): <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/tracking-dnt/" rel="nofollow">https://www.w3.org/TR/tracking-dnt/</a></li>
<li>MDN Guide on the Do Not Track initiative: <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Security/Do_not_track_field_guide" rel="nofollow">https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Security/Do_not_track_field_guide</a></li>
<li>MDN Article on <code class="notranslate">navigator.doNotTrack</code>: <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Navigator/doNotTrack" rel="nofollow">https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Navigator/doNotTrack</a></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">As a web developer, I'm interested in a JS polyfill that would check the User Agent for the user's Do Not Track setting. If <code class="notranslate">doNotTrack</code> is set, then I'd, for instance, not load up any client-side analytics.</p>
<p dir="auto">Thanks!</p></div></div><div class="IssueBodyTaskList__-FlQre"><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 flex-wrap"><div class="ReactionPopoverAnchor__B84pko"><button
